title: ever NOVA|Criss-Cross V-Neck Chiffon Backless A-Line Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stunning A-line bridesmaid dress is the ultimate selection in sophistication for your wedding day. A pleated criss-cross v-neckline with spaghetti straps, cinched waist, and striking draped backless fit give this romantic bridesmaid dress an air of vintage with contemporary styling.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Spaghetti straps.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.


Occasion: Formal, Evening party, Wedding guest, Prom, Banquet, Formal occasions, Special event, Bridesmaid
